english.title: PSV driver failed to ensure safety of passengers
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a public service vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), failed to take all reasonable precautions to ensure the safety of passengers who were

(A)_[on]_
(B)_[entering]_
(C)_[leaving]_
(D)_[on, entering or leaving]_

the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 5(1) of the Public Service Vehicles (Conduct of Drivers, Inspectors, Conductors and Passengers) Regulations 1990 and section 24(2) of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:

failed
to take all reasonable precautions
to ensure safety of passengers
entering/leaving the vehicle

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) In addition to the above, regulation 5 deals with other forms of misconduct by a driver.
(ii) See section 68(1) of the Passenger Vehicles Act 1981 for defence.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) Further detail may be included in relation to any danger or injury caused to passengers, and any explanation given by the defendant. Also, whether the defendant has retained his/her office as driver.
